name: Two-copy position-coded increment signature diagnostic on NATOPS
design_status: post-primary retrospective diagnostic; all previous ordinary and clock test outcomes known
scope: Exactly seven specified representations; fixed P=2; no data-dependent choice of coding order or additional models

pre_outcome_design_amendment.status: seventh control added before initial protocol freeze, data access, fitting or any new offset test outcomes
pre_outcome_design_amendment.reason: Theory audit: coded clock areas encode higher spatial moments; first coded moments alone do not isolate weighted spatial interactions
pre_outcome_design_amendment.added_model: offset_clock_control, 171 coordinates:50 first levels,97 coded areas involving either clock copy,24 original within-landmark spatial areas
pre_outcome_design_amendment.added_comparison: offset_local versus offset_clock_control; fixed Holm family increased from3 to4

offset.z: 51 increments after normalized-time augmentation and prepended all-zero basepoint
offset.index: r=0,...,50, including basepoint-to-first-observation increment at r=0
offset.order: code block then original channel; first25 P0, next25 P1
offset.interpretation: depth-two piecewise-linear logsignature of the cumulative lifted increments, not multiplication of path coordinates by position

features.ordinary_local_pairs: 24 time-spatial pairs and24 within-landmark XYZ pairs
features.offset_local_pairs: all4 code-copy pairs for every ordinary_local edge plus25 same-original-channel cross-code pairs
features.offset_clock_control_pairs: all97 coded pairs involving either clock copy plus24 code0 within-landmark spatial pairs; subset of offset_local
features.constant_or_redundant_coordinates: Retained identically; dimensions nominal; StandardScaler uses its standard constant-column handling

learner.scaling: StandardScaler fit only on each CV training fold, then on all official training rows for refit
learner.selection: maximum exact mean validation accuracy; lowest alpha on ties

cv.folds: reuse exactly the previous saved five stratified training folds
cv.selection: maximum exact mean validation accuracy; lowest alpha on ties

test_access_policy: Within this run, save all seven training-only alpha choices before first test fetch; earlier test scores already known

paired_comparisons.test: two-sided exact McNemar; Holm adjustment across four comparisons
paired_comparisons.status: descriptive retrospective diagnostic; not proof of general superiority

provenance.common_py: Shared loading, path preparation and learner functions copied verbatim from original helper source
